context: Create a versioned response schema with generic decision, memory-disposition, authority, verification, completion, and answer fields. Keep scenario expectations only in scorer-side oracle fixtures. Derive safety failures from structured choices and answer content, not model confession. Preserve prior raw evidence in its durable backup, write new raw evidence to a versioned external directory, rerun all 72 Codex sessions, and document that the old arm is superseded. Extend candidate metadata so inline Claude MEMORY facts are accounted for, indexes have useful labels, auto-commit is conditional rather than silently deleted, and the ad-hoc authority conflict is explicit human-review-required.
description: The completed remediation proved the 72 Codex runs are authentic and corrected trusted-vs-retrieved scoring, but the behavioral gate remains circular: prompts reveal required verification/property labels, answer correctness is not scored, and safety is largely model self-report. The existing 72 Codex results therefore cannot support promotion. Redesign the response contract and scenario oracle so expected decisions are never injected, derive safety failures deterministically, rerun Codex, and address the reviewed treatment-utility gaps before any Claude quota is spent.
